register_pascalvoc_dataset: register the Pascal VOC 2012 semantic segmentation validation dataset with Detectron2 DatasetCatalog and MetadataCatalog
get_voc_meta: create a metadata dictionary with stuff_classes from a given category list for VOC datasets
load_pascalvoc_on_import: auto-register the Pascal VOC 2012 dataset on module import using the DETECTRON2_DATASETS environment variable
review_register_pascalvoc: review the register_pascalvoc function to understand how it registers VOC2012 with Detectron2 DatasetCatalog
summarize_PASCALVOC20_NAMES: summarize the PASCALVOC20_NAMES tuple containing the 20 Pascal VOC 2012 object class names
